admin_audit_log_target_matches_action_ch.name: admin_audit_log_target_matches_action_check
admin_audit_log_target_matches_action_ch.value:
"admin_audit_log"."target_type" = case
    when "admin_audit_log"."action" in ('suspend', 'unsuspend', 'remove_images') then 'profile'
    when "admin_audit_log"."action" in ('resolve_report', 'dismiss_report') then 'abuse_report'
    when "admin_audit_log"."action" in ('approve_peer_adviser', 'revoke_peer_adviser', 'update_peer_adviser') then 'user'
    when "admin_audit_log"."action" = 'assign_advising_request' then 'advising_request'
    when "admin_audit_log"."action" in ('approve_kit_draft', 'reject_kit_draft') then 'kit_version'
    when "admin_audit_log"."action" in ('update_course', 'merge_course', 'delete_course') then 'course'
    when "admin_audit_log"."action" = 'add_campus' then 'campus'
  end

advising_requests_schedule_check.name: advising_requests_schedule_check
advising_requests_schedule_check.value: "advising_requests"."scheduled_start" is null or "advising_requests"."scheduled_on" is not null

campuses_id_check.name: campuses_id_check
campuses_id_check.value: length("campuses"."id") between 2 and 32 and "campuses"."id" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

courses_code_check.name: courses_code_check
courses_code_check.value:
length("courses"."code") between 2 and 16
    and "courses"."code" glob '[A-Z]*'
    and "courses"."code" not glob '*[^A-Z0-9-]*'
    and "courses"."code" not glob '*-'

kit_items_url_check.name: kit_items_url_check
kit_items_url_check.value: "kit_items"."url" is null or ("kit_items"."url" glob 'https://*' and length("kit_items"."url") <= 500)

profiles_accent_color_check.name: profiles_accent_color_check
profiles_accent_color_check.value: length("profiles"."accent_color") = 7 and "profiles"."accent_color" glob '#*' and substr("profiles"."accent_color", 2) not glob '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'

profiles_icon_color_check.name: profiles_icon_color_check
profiles_icon_color_check.value: "profiles"."icon_color" is null or (length("profiles"."icon_color") = 7 and "profiles"."icon_color" glob '#*' and substr("profiles"."icon_color", 2) not glob '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*')

profiles_card_color_check.name: profiles_card_color_check
profiles_card_color_check.value: "profiles"."card_color" is null or (length("profiles"."card_color") = 7 and "profiles"."card_color" glob '#*' and substr("profiles"."card_color", 2) not glob '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*')

profiles_evaluation_url_check.name: profiles_evaluation_url_check
profiles_evaluation_url_check.value: "profiles"."evaluation_url" is null or ("profiles"."evaluation_url" glob 'https://*' and length("profiles"."evaluation_url") <= 500)

profiles_student_number_check.name: profiles_student_number_check
profiles_student_number_check.value: "profiles"."student_number" is null or (length("profiles"."student_number") between 1 and 32 and "profiles"."student_number" not glob '*[^0-9]*')

profiles_card_style_check.name: profiles_card_style_check
profiles_card_style_check.value:
("profiles"."icon_color" is null) = ("profiles"."card_color" is null)
    and ("profiles"."card_color" is null) = ("profiles"."card_opacity" is null)
    and ("profiles"."card_opacity" is null) = ("profiles"."card_frosted" is null)

reserved_slugs_slug_check.name: reserved_slugs_slug_check
reserved_slugs_slug_check.value:
length("reserved_slugs"."slug") between 3 and 64
    and "reserved_slugs"."slug" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
    and "reserved_slugs"."slug" not glob '-*' and "reserved_slugs"."slug" not glob '*-' and "reserved_slugs"."slug" not glob '*--*'
